description: List workflow definitions (GET /workflows) with optional name, trigger and interval filters, one page per call (page_length up to 50). Completion carries data, the vendor pagination object and next_page. Returns job_id/status queued at once; dispatch is not completion.
embedding_description: List Zuora Workflow definitions on the registered tenant, one page at a time, filtered by name, callout, on-demand or scheduled trigger and CRON interval. Use it to inventory workflows before a backup, find a workflow id by name, or check which versions are active. Returns definitions plus the next page number.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Queued job envelope. Completion carries operation, method, path, status, correlation_id, data (Zuora's data array and pagination object) and pagination {page, next_page, vendor}; next_page is null on the last page.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Queued is not completion. On completion relay HTTP status, ids and states exactly as Zuora returned them; a write or delete may have changed vendor state, so do not replay it automatically.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: List workflow definitions (GET /workflows) with optional name, trigger and interval filters, one page per call (page_length up to 50). Completion carries data, the vendor pagination object and next_page.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: zuora.invalid_params is input that does not match Zuora's documented shape or an output/input path outside saved locations (zuora.export_path_refused). zuora.permission_denied is the vendor's 403 for the registered OAuth client's role, with Zuora's reason. zuora.object_not_found, zuora.validation_failed (vendor 4xx), zuora.query_failed (Data Query 4xx), zuora.rate_limited and zuora.api_error map Zuora's answer; zuora.auth_failed is a 401 credential failure.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Correct the parameters, or ask the Zuora administrator to grant the OAuth client's role the needed Workflow, Data Query or Files permission. Read current vendor state with the matching get or list verb before retrying a write. Back off on rate limits.
